orig: Nos pegan… Como? Que? Que dixeches, que? … NOS PEGAN
en: They hit us… What? Huh? What did you say, huh? … THEY HIT US
es: Nos pegan… ¿Cómo? ¿Qué? ¿Qué dijiste, qué? … NOS PEGAN
eu: Jotzen gaituzte… Zer? Zer? Zer esan duzu, zer? … JOTZEN GAITUZTE

questions.original: Nos pegan… Como? Que? Que dixeches, que? … NOS PEGAN
questions.issue: 'Que dixeches' is Galician (confirmed by you); the rest is Spanish. 'Nos pegan' = they hit us (violence); it could also mean 'they stick to us'. I chose violence.
